verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list prefix caching as a built-in engine feature alongside continuous batching and chunked prefill, so the capability is first-party. However, the evidence is a single feature-list mention with no detail on enabling it, how it works, or the speedup it gives for repeated prompts. Missing for 10: documentation of how to enable or configure prefix caching, any evidence of the speedup on repeated or shared-prefix workloads, and independent or hands-on corroboration specific to prefix caching.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can speed up repeated-prompt workloads using prefix caching

citations.quote: Continuous batching of incoming requests, chunked prefill, prefix caching
